threads.preview:
That is what I want to hear. Lock it in.

Quick checklist before you touch a bar

paragraphs: Look, you said you were going to get back on the board with a lift, and you got 23 minutes in yesterday morning. It breaks the dry spell. Let me know what you actually hit in that session, what the RPE was, and if we're still locking in another lift this weekend.

messages.text: That was just morning foundation coach

messages.text: I will do it today coach!

paragraphs:
That is what I want to hear. Lock it in.

Quick checklist before you touch a bar:
1. Single-leg glute bridge on the right in the warm-up. Squeeze before extending.
2. Front lever protocol: SL FL benchmark tested LEFT first, then straddle negatives (25kg band, 5x3 controlled), then SL holds (15kg band, 3x10s).
3. Dips stay at bodyweight with that 3-second eccentric.

Keep it clean, get your numbers down, and tell me how it felt when you're done.

Rest is the plan today. Get some real food in, shut the eyes early, and let's get you recovered before you travel.

messages.text: Tomorrow I will do my scheduled Workout A though.

paragraphs: Look, that makes complete sense. I moved Workout A to tomorrow on the plan. Tonight is about one thing: get to bed early, bank real sleep, and reset the nervous system. When you wake up rested, that bar and those rings will feel completely different. Let's get after it tomorrow.

messages.text: Added scores now. Felt good coach. I was great today. Shots were in control. Played a calm game and enjoyed the session

paragraphs: Look, that calm control under game speed is exactly what we're after. When your shots are dialed and you're actually enjoying the fight out there, that free state isn't an accident anymore, it's becoming who you are on court. Get your food in, hydrate, and let the body recover tonight.

messages.text: Thanks coach. Did you see the scores? I was rank 1 today

paragraphs: I can't see the specific match numbers on this screen, but Rank 1 speaks for itself. Walking into Hit and Run, staying calm when it gets chaotic, and coming out on top without forcing it - that's huge. That's what happens when you trust your game. Bank the confidence, get your protein in, and get some sleep.
